DATA SECURITY ADDENDUM - Cindermark Data Services (Vendor) and Meridian Crest Health System (Customer), under the MSA dated January 15, 2026.
1.5 Vendor Security means Vendor's technological, physical, administrative and procedural safeguards to protect Customer Data.
2.2 Vendor shall implement technological, physical, administrative, and procedural safeguards consistent with Industry Standards to protect Customer Data.
2.4 Security Coordinator. Vendor shall assign an individual to serve as Security Coordinator responsible for the obligations in this Addendum.
2.5 PCI Compliance. If Vendor has access to or processes payment-card data, Vendor shall comply with PCI-DSS.
2.8 Indemnification. Without limiting any indemnity under the Agreement, Vendor shall indemnify Customer for losses arising from a Security Incident caused by Vendor.
2.9 Limitation of Liability. Notwithstanding anything to the contrary, Vendor's liability for a Security Incident is not subject to the general liability cap.
3.1 Vendor shall provide Customer a written incident report within five (5) business days after initial notification.
[End of Addendum]
